name: co_ccpvtz_j
description: #570's f case: CO in cc-pVTZ, Cartesian (ten f components), off every axis, f on both atoms. Records the converted basis and PySCF's get_jk J for the recorded density; the one-electron arrays are its two pieces', co_ccpvtz_j_st and co_ccpvtz_j_vh.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate co_ccpvtz_j

density_recipe: hilbert: D[i][j] = 1/(i+j+1) -- symmetric positive definite, no RNG, reproducible bit-for-bit on any host
